name: Neo Bananas
description:
About This Game

Story

It’s 21XX and you’re the last gorilla on Earth.

Barely saved by a group of humans and upgraded into a cyborg, you’re trying to take down the evil tech corporation that made your species extinct. Most fruits on Earth have been hoarded by the tech giants to power their datacenters and machines, and have been replaced by a digitally-altered synthetic version called “Neo Fruits”.

Your goal is to follow the trail of Neo Bananas and destroy all of them. Neo fruits are used towards the adventure as weapons and explosives to help you restore the real fruits into the world.

Go fast.

Go wild.

Go bananas!

Features

  • Single player

  • Destroy 8 bananas in every levels to win!

  • Speedrun-focused - beat a target time in every level to unlock the next world

  • Collect 3 hidden purple gems per level

  • 4 worlds and 40+ levels

  • Open-arena levels - go left, go right, go up, or go down... there's no linear path!

  • Ranking system from D to S+

  • Race against ghosts of your best runs

  • Online leaderboards & individual level speedrun statistics - see your pace after each bananas destroyed

  • Precise platformer with action powerups

Inspirations

This game is inspired by the BREAK THE TARGET minigame from the older Smash Bros. It is also a spiritual successor to my previous game GOLIATH DEPOT and a love letter to many old school mascot platformers.

Credits

NO GenAI WAS USED DURING THE CREATION OF THIS GAME.

Everything is handcrafted: each line of codes is written manually in the Godot Engine, every line of dialogues has been thought by a human, every pixel has been drawn in Aseprite, and every song & sfx has been composed by a musician.

  • Design by Vidvad

  • Programming by Vidvad

  • Pixel art by Vidvad

  • Music by Julien Guillemette

  • Additional VFX asset packs by Will Tice

  • Fonts by somepx

  • Key art & logo by Vidvad
